$comment: Single source of truth for quality thresholds. Protected from agent edits by quality/hooks/protect-config.mjs. Change only by hand.

testsOutsideGate.reason: Playwright E2E (apps/web test:e2e): drives next build + next start in a browser; runs in CI's e2e job, not as a vitest project.

stopHook.$comment: mutation: "changed" makes the Stop hook run gate.mjs all (check + mutation of uncommitted source); any other value runs gate.mjs check only. mychess runs the fast gate only; mutation runs in CI (quality.yml).
